lore.block.aether_genesis.blood_moss_hol: An unbreakable stone found at the edges of labyrinths, covered in an off-putting red moss.
lore.block.aether_genesis.blue_skyroot_l: These leaves generate with Blue Skyroot Trees. They can drop Blue Skyroot Saplings and Skyroot Sticks when decaying.
lore.block.aether_genesis.blue_skyroot_s: These small blue saplings will grow into Skyroot Trees. They can be grown faster with Bone Meal.
lore.block.aether_genesis.carved_pillar: The main part of pillars found in the Bronze Dungeon; they pair well with Carved Stone for building.
lore.block.aether_genesis.carved_pillar_: The top part of the pillars found in the Bronze Dungeon; their carvings look good and pair well with Carved Stone for building.
lore.block.aether_genesis.continuum_ore: A rare ore found in the Aether. It will drop a Continuum Orb when mined with a Gravitite Pickaxe.
lore.block.aether_genesis.dark_blue_skyr: These leaves generate with Dark Blue Skyroot Trees. They can drop Dark Blue Skyroot Saplings and Skyroot Sticks when decaying.
These dark blue saplings will grow into a towering type of Skyroot Tree. They can be grown faster with Bone Meal.
lore.block.aether_genesis.divine_carved_: Crafted from Divine Carved Stone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building's roofing!
Crafted from Divine Carved Stone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
Carved Stone that has blue grooves cut between the bricks. A fancy block to decorate with alongside its regular counterpart!
Crafted from Mossy Divine Carved Stone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defenses. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
lore.block.aether_genesis.divine_sentry_: Sentry Stone that has blue grooves cut between the bricks. A fancy block to decorate with alongside its regular counterpart!
lore.block.aether_genesis.enchanted_gras: A Grass Block that has been enchanted to allow for increasing harvest rates of Blue Berries.
lore.block.aether_genesis.green_aercloud: A pastel green cloud found across the skies of the Aether. These can bounce you horizontally in any random direction, so be careful to not fly into them with your Moa!
lore.block.aether_genesis.holystone_furn: A furnace constructed from Holystone. This can be used to cook both ores and food while surviving in the Aether.
lore.block.aether_genesis.holystone_head: A decorative variant of Holystone Bricks that can be oriented directionally. The top has rounded carvings resembling a Valkyrie.
lore.block.aether_genesis.holystone_high: A decorative variant of Holystone Bricks that can be oriented directionally. This block can work for adding variation and accenting among other bricks.
lore.block.aether_genesis.holystone_keys: A decorative variant of Holystone Bricks that can be oriented directionally. Useful for bases or arches in your builds.
lore.block.aether_genesis.orange_tree: A dwarf Orange Tree, found naturally across the islands of the Aether. It only grows to be as tall as a Player!
lore.block.aether_genesis.purple_aerclou: A light purple cloud found at low elevations, emitting directional particles of air. Landing in a Purple Aercloud will launch you in the same direction as the particles, which can be used for momentum during flight.
lore.block.aether_genesis.purple_crystal: Purple Crystal Leaves that are home to White Apples.
Leaves that come from Purple Crystal Trees, found amongst wooded areas. Sometimes they bear fruit on them that can cure Inebriation.
These spindly saplings will grow into tall Crystal Trees with purple leaves. They can be grown faster with Bone Meal.
lore.block.aether_genesis.skyroot_chest: A Skyroot container that can be used to store all the goods you collect on your adventures.
lore.block.aether_genesis.skyroot_chest_: It may look like a normal Skyroot Chest, but it really isn't. As soon as you right-click on it, a Chest Mimic will pop out! These appear in Bronze and Silver Dungeons.
lore.block.aether_genesis.skyroot_crafti: A workbench made of Skyroot, capable of crafting anything you might need.
lore.block.aether_genesis.skyroot_ladder: A Skyroot Ladder. Handy for vertical travel.
lore.block.aether_genesis.skyroot_log_wa: Crafted from Skyroot Logs. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defenses. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
lore.block.aether_genesis.skyroot_wood_w: Crafted from Skyroot Wood. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defenses. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
lore.block.aether_genesis.storm_aercloud: A dark, dim cloud found near the bottom of the Aether. Some say this is where Tempests originate from at nightfall.
lore.block.aether_genesis.stripped_skyro: Crafted from Stripped Skyroot Logs. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defenses. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
Crafted from Stripped Skyroot Wood. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defenses. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
lore.item.aether_genesis.baby_pink_swet: A cute Swet companion that that makes other Swets become friendly towards you, allowing you to ride them.
lore.item.aether_genesis.blue_parachute: A parachute that can boost you high into the air. It is crafted with Blue Aerclouds and can only be used once.
lore.item.aether_genesis.blue_swet_jelly: A morsel of fluted gelatin made by sweetening Blue Swet Gel with Sugar.
lore.item.aether_genesis.blueberry_lolli: A hard, round sweet candy on a Stick.
lore.item.aether_genesis.bone_ring: A ring made of bone and carved with spiky protrusions. It grants the wearer extra attack damage.
lore.item.aether_genesis.candy_corn: A piece of pointy, horn-shaped candy made from Sugar and Cornstarch.
lore.item.aether_genesis.candy_ring: A patterned ring resembling a Candy Cane, which freezes the process of losing hunger.
lore.item.aether_genesis.cape: A Cape that is crafted using soft White Wool. It is able to be dyed any color!
lore.item.aether_genesis.cocoatrice: A large and solid chocolate, molded into a shape resembling a Cockatrice.
lore.item.aether_genesis.cog_key: A dark key with a matte look. It is dropped from the Labyrinth Eye after being defeated. You can use it to claim the treasure you earned!
lore.item.aether_genesis.continuum_bomb: Harnessing the power of volatile spacetime, you can give yourself a colorful party filled with randomly-sourced rewards!
lore.item.aether_genesis.continuum_orb: An orange crystalline ball of unstable spacetime, breaking it will yield a random item from an unknown point. Maybe it will provide something useful?
lore.item.aether_genesis.cornstarch_bowl: A large bowl of ground corn flour found among chests in Bronze and Silver Dungeons. It is a vital ingredient in making Candy Corn.
lore.item.aether_genesis.crystal_experie: A crystalline bottle that can be used to hold the Player's experience points. When interacting, experience will be taken out of the bottle, except when crouching, then experience will be put into the bottle.
lore.item.aether_genesis.daggerfrost_loc: A Pendant that makes Snowballs thrown by the wearer inflict damage. This pairs well with the Frostbound Stone.
lore.item.aether_genesis.dark_gummy_swet: A gummy with a minty aftertaste that can be found in chests in Bronze and Silver Dungeons. It fully restores the Player's hunger when eaten. Very useful for boss fights.
lore.item.aether_genesis.dark_swet_ball: A gooey orb that is dropped from Dark Swets. It can be used to fertilize soil. Another use is to put it alongside String to make a Lead.
lore.item.aether_genesis.dark_swet_jelly: A morsel of fluted gelatin made by sweetening Dark Swet Gel with Sugar.
lore.item.aether_genesis.death_seal: An ancient seal containing a Nex Spirit. This spirit will save you from death and bring you back to full health, but with a slow cooldown.
lore.item.aether_genesis.dexterity_cape: An uncommon Cape found in Bronze Dungeons. It makes the wearer's legs stronger, allowing them to run at a faster speed.
lore.item.aether_genesis.ethereal_stone: A stone covered in glowing purple runes. It activates into a wisp that makes you completely invisible! Since mobs cannot see you, they cannot attack you. Sneak up on your enemies with it!
lore.item.aether_genesis.fangrin_capsule: A small round capsule that summons a Fangrin to aide you in battle. This shelled creature has no bark, but it has a strong bite.
lore.item.aether_genesis.fleeting_stone: A stone covered in glowing green runes. It activates into a wisp that makes your legs stronger, allowing you to walk up blocks instantly.
lore.item.aether_genesis.frostbound_ston: A stone covered in frost. It activates into a sprite that generates up to 16 Snowballs in your inventory. This pairs well with the Daggerfrost Locket.
lore.item.aether_genesis.frostpine_totem: A totem carved with the visages of a Moa, a Gruegar, and a Zephyr. It grants the wearer the ability to see in the dark, which can be useful for finding ores under islands!
lore.item.aether_genesis.golden_swet_bal: A gooey orb that is dropped from Golden Swets. It can be used to fertilize soil. Another use is to put it alongside String to make a Lead.
lore.item.aether_genesis.golden_swet_jel: A morsel of fluted gelatin made by sweetening Golden Swet Gel with Sugar.
lore.item.aether_genesis.green_parachute: A parachute that allows you more freedom of movement horizontally during descent. It is crafted with Green Aerclouds and can only be used once.
lore.item.aether_genesis.guardian_key: A blueish pewter key that is dropped from the Sentry Guardian after being defeated. You can use it to claim the treasure you earned!
lore.item.aether_genesis.host_key: A crimson-colored key that is dropped from the Slider Host Mimic after being defeated. You can use it to claim the treasure you earned!
lore.item.aether_genesis.icestone_poproc: Powdery Icestone rock candies that pop in your mouth!
lore.item.aether_genesis.jelly_pumpkin: A delicious Orange-flavored gelatin. Does not contain real Pumpkin!
lore.item.aether_genesis.kraisith_capsul: A small round capsule that summons a Kraisith to aide you in battle. It will attempt to shoot enchanted needles at a foe from a distance.
lore.item.aether_genesis.lucky_bell: A red collar with a bell attached to it. When worn, it makes slain enemies occasionally drop Presents.
lore.item.aether_genesis.mouse_ear_cap: A wearable cap that makes it look like you have big mouse ears! It can be dyed any color.
lore.item.aether_genesis.music_disc_aerw: A music disc that plays "Aerwhale" by Aether UK.
lore.item.aether_genesis.music_disc_appr: A music disc that plays "Approaches" by Emile van Krieken.
lore.item.aether_genesis.music_disc_demi: A music disc that plays "Demise" by Moorziey.
lore.item.aether_genesis.orange: A tangy Orange, grown from naturally occurring dwarf Orange Trees. These fill more hunger than Blue Berries, but aren't as common.
lore.item.aether_genesis.orange_lollipop: A hard, round tangy candy on a Stick.
lore.item.aether_genesis.orb_of_arkenzus: An orb that projects an avatar of Arkenzus, making you lighter than air and able to descend slowly.
lore.item.aether_genesis.phoenix_dart_sh: A Dart Shooter that can shoot any type of dart, and sets them on fire!
lore.item.aether_genesis.purple_parachut: A parachute that propels you forward at a high speed. It is crafted with Purple Aerclouds and can only be used once.
lore.item.aether_genesis.rainbow_strawbe: A powerful enchanted fruit, good for hunger and saturation as well as a couple seconds of damage resistance and mining speed.
lore.item.aether_genesis.recording_892: A music disc that plays an eerie recording.
lore.item.aether_genesis.skyroot_ring: A wooden ring that gives the rare chance of doubling drops.
lore.item.aether_genesis.soaring_stone: A stone covered in glowing blue runes. It activates into a wisp that makes your legs stronger, allowing you to run at a faster speed.
lore.item.aether_genesis.stomper_pop: A gooey, round candy made from a Baby Pink Swet. It will fill you up, but was it worth it?
lore.item.aether_genesis.swetty_pendant: A Pendant with a bauble resembling a Swet attached to it. Moving against vertical surfaces allows the wearer to slide down them without falling.
lore.item.aether_genesis.wrapped_chocola: An assortment of delicious chocolates wrapped in bits of Aechor Petal.
lore.item.aether_genesis.wyndberry: A blue strawberry-like fruit dropped from Carrion Sprouts when killed. Wyndberries are one of the most filling natural fruits in the Aether, and can be enchanted in an Altar to grant additional effects.
